pairsWith.noteUz: Present perfect vs past simple, since/for, present perfect continuous, o'zlik olmoshlari coursebook 50-51-betlar grammatikasiga mos keladi.

scanNote:
WORKBOOK 7-UNITNING UChINChI BETI (32-bet). Yuqorida chapda to'q sariq '7' va 'Profiles'.

CHAP USTUN:
9) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect or the past simple.' A: What's the matter, Bill? B: I 1) ...... (hurt) my arm. A: Oh, when 2) ...... (you/do) that? B: I 3) ...... (do) it yesterday when I was playing football. A: Is it still painful? B: Well, it 4) ...... (hurt) a lot when it 5) ...... (happen). A: 6) ...... (you/see) a doctor yet? B: Yes, I 7) ...... (go) last night but I 8) ...... (not/break) any bones and I just need to rest. A: No football for you for a while, then! B: Oh, I don't know about that! I 9) ...... (never/injure) myself playing football before. Besides, I'm sure I'll be okay in a few days.
10) 'Look at the pictures and complete the dialogues using the correct reflexive pronoun and should/shouldn't.' 5 SURAT: 1 bola, burni kesilgan (onasi qarayapti): A: What's happened? B: I've cut ...... . A: You ...... be more careful. 2 qiz o'tloqda oyog'ini ushlab: A: What's wrong? B: She's hurt ...... . A: She ...... walk for a while. 3 basseynda odamlar: A: What are they doing? B: They're enjoying ...... in the pool. A: They ...... exercise more often. 4 tennischi o'rindiqda oyog'ini ushlab: A: What's wrong? B: He's injured ...... . A: He ...... play tennis for a while. 5 (o'ng yuqorida) og'ir yuk ko'targan erkak belini ushlab: A: What's happened? B: I've hurt ...... . A: You ...... lift such heavy weights.

O'NG USTUN:
11a) 'Fill in since or for.' 1 ...... the last three years 2 ...... yesterday 3 ...... six months 4 ...... breakfast time 5 ...... 1998 6 ...... I was six 7 ...... last Monday 8 ...... we moved house 9 ...... two o'clock 10 ...... four hours.
11b) 'Now make up sentences using the present perfect simple and five of the phrases above.' Qiya namuna: 'She has lived in Japan for the last three years.'
12) 'Match the pictures to the prompts. Then, expand them into full sentences using the present perfect continuous with for or since.' 5 SURAT: A JIM CAREY [kitobda shunday; to'g'risi Carrey]; B CHER; C WHITNEY HOUSTON; D MICHAEL CHANG (tennischi); E TARA LIPINSKI (figurachi). 1 play / professional tennis / over ten years 2 record / hit songs / 1965 3 skate / she was three years old 4 make / albums / fourteen years 5 act / comedy films / 1977.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '32'.
⚠ Suratlar manbai - 3-bet Acknowledgements: Ace Ventura (Jim Carrey), Cher, The Bodyguard (Whitney Houston), Tara Lipinski.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present perfect or the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present perfect yoki past simple shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT vs PAST SIMPLE
  (coursebook 50-bet qoidasi).

  PRESENT PERFECT - natija HOZIR,
  vaqt AYTILMAGAN:
    'I've hurt my arm' (hozir
    og'riyapti)
    'Have you seen a doctor yet?'
    'I haven't broken any bones'
    'I've never injured myself'
  PAST SIMPLE - ANIQ O'TGAN VAQT:
    'when did you do that?' (when)
    'I did it yesterday'
    'it hurt when it happened'
    'I went last night'

  ⚠ 'when', 'yesterday', 'last
  night' → PAST SIMPLE.
  ⚠ 'yet', 'never', vaqtsiz →
  PRESENT PERFECT.


⚠ 'WHAT'S THE MATTER?':

  = Nima bo'ldi? (= What's wrong?)


⚠ 'PAINFUL':

  = og'riqli.


⚠ 'TO INJURE ONESELF':

  = o'zini jarohatlamoq.


⚠ 'BESIDES':

  = bundan tashqari.


⚠ 'FOR A WHILE':

  = bir muddat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz: ⚠ Natija hozir, vaqt yo'q → present perfect.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I 3) ___ (do) it yesterday when I was playing football.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Well, it 4) ___ (hurt) a lot when it 5) ___ (happen).
lines.whyUz: ⚠ 'when it happened' - aniq o'tgan payt → ikkalasi past simple (hurt → hurt).

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Yes, I 7) ___ (go) last night but I 8) ___ (not/break) any bones and I just need to rest.
lines.uz: Ha, kecha kechqurun bordim, lekin suyaklarim sinmagan va faqat dam olishim kerak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: No football for you for a while, then!
lines.uz: Unda bir muddat senga futbol yo'q!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Oh, I don't know about that! I 9) ___ (never/injure) myself playing football before. Besides, I'm sure I'll be okay in a few days.
lines.uz: Bilmadim! Ilgari hech qachon futbol o'ynab o'zimni jarohatlamaganman. Bundan tashqari, bir necha kunda tuzalib ketishimga ishonaman.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and complete the dialogues using the correct reflexive pronoun and should/shouldn't. Pictures: 1 boy with a cut nose; 2 girl holding her leg on the grass; 3 people in a pool; 4 tennis player holding his leg; 5 man lifting weights holding his back.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va dialoglarni to'g'ri o'zlik olmoshi va should/shouldn't bilan to'ldiring. Rasmlar: 1 burni kesilgan bola; 2 o'tloqda oyog'ini ushlagan qiz; 3 basseyndagi odamlar; 4 oyog'ini ushlagan tennischi; 5 og'ir yuk ko'targan, belini ushlagan erkak.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'ZLIK OLMOShLARI (Reflexive
  Pronouns).

  I → myself
  you → yourself / yourselves
  he → himself
  she → herself
  it → itself
  we → ourselves
  they → themselves

  ⚠ Ega va to'ldiruvchi BIR ODAM
  bo'lsa: 'I've cut MYSELF'.


⚠ 'TO ENJOY ONESELF':

  = ko'ngil ochmoq, zavqlanmoq
  ('They're enjoying themselves').


SHOULD / SHOULDN'T:

  1 should be more careful
  2 shouldn't walk
  3 should exercise more often
  4 shouldn't play tennis
  5 shouldn't lift heavy weights


⚠ 'TO LIFT WEIGHTS':

  = og'irlik ko'tarmoq.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: He ___ play tennis for a while.
lines.uz: U bir muddat tennis o'ynamasligi kerak.

exercises.explanationUz:
SINCE / FOR (coursebook 50-bet).

  FOR + DAVOMIYLIK (qancha vaqt):
    for the last three years, for
    six months, for four hours
  SINCE + BOShLANISh NUQTASI
    (qachondan):
    since yesterday, since breakfast
    time, since 1998, since I was
    six, since last Monday, since
    we moved house, since two
    o'clock

  ⚠ 'since' dan keyin GAP ham
  kelishi mumkin: 'since I was six',
  'since we moved house'.


⚠ 'TO MOVE HOUSE':

  = ko'chib o'tmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Now make up sentences using the present perfect simple and five of the phrases above.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi present perfect simple va yuqoridagi iboralardan beshtasi bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT + SINCE/FOR.

  QOLIP: X has/have + V3 + ... +
  for/since ...

  ⚠ O'tmishda boshlanib HOZIRGAChA
  davom etayotgan holat.
exercises.exampleEn: She has lived in Japan for the last three years.
exercises.exampleUz: U so'nggi uch yildan beri Yaponiyada yashaydi.
modelAnswers: I have been ill since yesterday.
They have worked here for six months.
I have played the piano since I was six.
We have waited for four hours.
modelAnswersUz: Ular olti oydan beri shu yerda ishlashadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures to the prompts. Then, expand them into full sentences using the present perfect continuous with for or since. A Jim Carrey, B Cher, C Whitney Houston, D Michael Chang, E Tara Lipinski. 1 play / professional tennis / over ten years 2 record / hit songs / 1965 3 skate / she was three years old 4 make / albums / fourteen years 5 act / comedy films / 1977
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarni ko'rsatmalarga moslang. So'ng ularni present perfect continuous, for yoki since bilan to'liq gaplarga aylantiring. A Jim Kerri, B Sher, C Uitni Xyuston, D Maykl Chang, E Tara Lipinski. 1 play / professional tennis / over ten years 2 record / hit songs / 1965 3 skate / she was three years old 4 make / albums / fourteen years 5 act / comedy films / 1977
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS
  (coursebook 51-bet).

  has/have BEEN + V-ing + for/since
  = ... dan beri ... qilib keladi
  (davom etayotgan faoliyat).

  1 → D Michael Chang (tennischi)
    - for over ten years
  2 → B Cher (qo'shiqchi, 1965 dan)
    - since 1965
  3 → E Tara Lipinski (figurachi)
    - since she was three
  4 → C Whitney Houston (albomlar)
    - for fourteen years
  5 → A Jim Carrey (komediya)
    - since 1977


⚠ MAShHURLAR:

  Jim Carrey - amerikalik komediya
    aktyori ('Ace Ventura')
  Cher - amerikalik qo'shiqchi
  Whitney Houston - qo'shiqchi
    ('The Bodyguard')
  Michael Chang - amerikalik
    tennischi
  Tara Lipinski - figurali uchish
    olimpiya chempioni (1998)


⚠ 'HIT SONGS':

  = xit qo'shiqlar.


⚠ 'TO RECORD':

  = yozib olmoq (studiyada).

pairs.left: 1 play / professional tennis / over ten years
pairs.right: D Michael Chang - He has been playing professional tennis for over ten years.
pairs.rightUz: D Maykl Chang - U o'n yildan ortiq professional tennis o'ynab keladi.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Tennischi → D. 'over ten years' - davomiylik → FOR.

pairs.right: B Cher - She has been recording hit songs since 1965.
pairs.rightUz: B Sher - U 1965-yildan beri xit qo'shiqlar yozib keladi.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Cher - 1965 dan qo'shiqchi → B. Yil → SINCE.

pairs.left: 3 skate / she was three years old
pairs.right: E Tara Lipinski - She has been skating since she was three years old.
pairs.rightUz: E Tara Lipinski - U uch yoshidan beri konkida uchib keladi.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Figurachi → E. 'she was three' - gap → SINCE.

pairs.right: C Whitney Houston - She has been making albums for fourteen years.
pairs.rightUz: C Uitni Xyuston - U o'n to'rt yildan beri albomlar chiqarib keladi.

pairs.right: A Jim Carrey - He has been acting in comedy films since 1977.
pairs.rightUz: A Jim Kerri - U 1977-yildan beri komediya filmlarida o'ynab keladi.
